en.title: WestJet Cuts 15 Routes and Exits Cuba Entirely, Shifting Capacity Back to Domestic Canada
en.summary: WestJet is cutting 15 routes across Europe, Latin America, the Caribbean, Hawaii and domestic Canada, including a complete exit from Cuba, citing soft transborder traffic and volatile fuel prices, and is redeploying capacity to its domestic mainline routes.
body: WestJet is restructuring its international network with cuts to 15 routes, citing a combination of soft transborder traffic and volatile fuel prices. The Calgary-based carrier said the move consolidates unprofitable point-to-point operations and redeploys aircraft capacity back into its domestic Canadian mainline routes, with seasonal transatlantic services operated by its Boeing 737 MAX 8 fleet among those affected.

The cancelled destinations include Halifax to Copenhagen and Madrid, Toronto to Glasgow, Montreal to San Andres Island in Colombia, Calgary to Guadalajara, Vancouver to Lihue in Hawaii, and Calgary to Lethbridge and Medicine Hat in Alberta. The largest withdrawal is Cuba, where WestJet is ending service to all seven of its destinations there: Cayo Coco, Cienfuegos, Cayo Largo del Sur, Havana, Holguin, Santa Clara and Varadero, which the report attributes to systemic fuel shortages, nationwide power outages and shifting travel patterns.

The report also points to a sharp fall in Canada-US travel, citing Statistics Canada data showing overall transborder air travel down 19%, vehicle border crossings down 31% compared with 2024 levels, and forward bookings for peak travel seasons down by more than 70%. WestJet is concentrating capacity on core domestic routes and the most popular US routes where demand remains strong enough to absorb higher operating costs.

facts.claim: WestJet is cutting 15 routes and redeploying capacity back into its domestic Canadian mainline routes, citing soft transborder traffic and volatile fuel prices.

Halifax to Copenhagen and Halifax to Madrid each lasted only a single season before being shelved, and Toronto to Glasgow is being permanently cut, leaving Edinburgh as the remaining Scottish connection.
WestJet is ending service to all seven of its Cuban destinations: Cayo Coco, Cienfuegos, Cayo Largo del Sur, Havana, Holguin, Santa Clara and Varadero.
The report attributes the Cuba exit to systemic fuel shortages, nationwide electrical blackouts and shifting travel patterns.

Statistics Canada data cited in the report show overall transborder air travel down 19%, vehicle border crossings down 31% compared with 2024 levels, and forward bookings for peak travel seasons down by more than 70%.
Calgary to Guadalajara was suspended after failing to maintain traffic numbers, Vancouver to Lihue was wound down, and Calgary to Medicine Hat and Calgary to Lethbridge were completely eliminated.

zh.title: 西捷航空砍15條航線、全面退出古巴運能轉回加拿大國內幹線
zh.summary: 西捷航空削減橫跨歐洲、拉丁美洲、加勒比地區、夏威夷與加拿大國內的15條航線，包括全面退出古巴，理由是跨境客運疲弱與燃油價格波動，運能將重新投入加拿大國內主幹線。
body: 西捷航空正在重組國際航網，削減15條航線，理由是跨境客運疲弱與燃油價格波動。這家以卡加利為基地的航空公司表示，此舉是整併無利可圖的點對點營運，把運能重新投入加拿大國內主幹線，其中部分季節性跨大西洋航線由波音737MAX8機隊執飛。
取消的目的地包括哈利法克斯往哥本哈根、哈利法克斯往馬德里、多倫多往格拉斯哥、蒙特婁往哥倫比亞聖安德烈斯島、卡加利往瓜達拉哈拉、溫哥華往夏威夷利胡埃，以及卡加利往萊斯布里奇與梅迪辛哈特。撤出幅度最大的是古巴，西捷航空將結束在當地的全部7個目的地服務，包括卡約科科、謝恩富戈斯、卡約拉戈德爾蘇爾、哈瓦那、奧爾金、聖克拉拉與巴拉德羅，報導將原因歸於系統性燃油短缺、全國性停電與旅遊型態改變。
報導另指出加拿大往美國的旅遊大幅下滑，引述加拿大統計局數據稱整體跨境航空旅遊下降19%、車輛跨境次數較2024年水準下降31%、旺季訂位更崩跌逾70%。西捷航空將把運能集中於國內核心航線，以及需求仍足以吸收成本上漲的最熱門美國航線。
